'''Jon Brygies''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] along with [[Stev Brygies]], his relative. Both were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-affiliated individuals around [[3642 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jon Brygies appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
